name: 97034 · Lake Oswego, OR
findings: ZIP 97034 (Lake Oswego) has 121 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97034 (Lake Oswego) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 97034 (Lake Oswego) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 12 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
